note: Set B is a strict subset of Set A, and the claims A adds are mostly harmful: five module-to-module series-connection claims asserted as "positive terminal to positive terminal" with invented quotes, plus two cable-tie claims that garble and misbind Notes 1 and 2 (one merges "current carrying cable" with "cable ties", the other invents an "all current carrying cables" condition). Both sets bind the stray digit "3" (the per-module symbol glyph in the text layer) as a value/label of individual modules, and both repeat the junction-box or SA2-27 "3" facts. Both also omit the page's key engineering facts: cable is USE-2, 10 G.A., cable ties are U.V. rated, the module is a SUNPREME GX290 frameless glass design (see E-502), and the #10G bonding jumper.
remarks: Text layer is garbled for the string labels: it renders SA1-1..SA1-4 as SA3-1..SA3-4 and SA2-14..SA2-18 as SA3-14..SA3-18 (the image shows SA1-1..SA1-13 and SA2-14..SA2-27), and it renders NEMA as ENMA and 10 G.A as 10.G.A. Both extractions inherit the SA3-* misreads. The repeated "3" (27x) and "11" (8x) tokens are legend symbol glyphs (solar module symbol and #10G bonding jumper symbol), not values, so any claim treating them as component values is unsupported. Note 1 (ALL CURRENT CARRYING CABLE IS USE-2, 10 G.A) is the most important electrical fact on the page and is missed by both sets. Connection/polarity claims cannot be verified at this image resolution; the fabricated bracketed quotes in Set A are not present in the text layer.
